mapper.insert: INSERT INTO natives_tbl ( member_id, region, native_registered_at, native_deadline ) SELECT member_id, REGEXP_SUBSTR(member_address, '^.*?[가-힣]+(시|군|구)(\\s+[가-힣]+(읍|면))?|^.*?(구|군|읍|면)'), CURRENT_DATE, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) FROM member_tbl WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND member_address IS NOT NULL;
